blockers.summary: Canonical typed model, strict Lattice tokenizer/parser and deterministic compiler mappings are implemented for the normative grammar surface. Runtime-only context commands parse but intentionally fail canonical compilation; remaining work is validation/hardening rather than parser scaffolding.

Core semantic validation is implemented for identifiers, references, vocabulary, permission/profile contradictions, resource scope and evidence support. Host authorization now enforces expiry at execution time; full semantic RFC3339/BCP47 validation remains incomplete.

Reference host authorization now implements exact capability/resource intersection, authenticated delegation attenuation, trusted authorization references, confirmation/review/logging gates, expiry and in-process replay/idempotency reservation. Durable/distributed replay storage and application-specific limit enforcement remain host integration work.

Positive/negative protocol vectors, canonical byte round trips, extended Lattice tests and host-authorization security tests exist; broader normative-vector coverage, fuzz/property coverage and cross-implementation fixtures remain incomplete.

Hostile-input, permission-escalation, delegation-widening, replay/action-mutation, evidence-provenance, Unicode/canonicalization and unresolved-context tests exist in part; systematic adversarial coverage remains incomplete.
No independent second implementation has passed the shared conformance vectors or reproduced canonical bytes.
Whitepaper publication revision, source figures and reproducible publication build are incomplete.
SLAI adapter/launcher and pinned package/submodule integration are not implemented.
Final clean release audit, migration policy, compatibility evidence and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
